source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API
notes: Kain's 5th-job set is the 4 class-specific actives ([Possess] Dragon Burst, [Execute] Fatal Blitz, Thanatos Descent, Grip of Agony) plus the shared Bowman V skills Guided Arrow, Vicious Shot and Fury of the Wild (the same shared set in the bowmaster/marksman folders); Fury of the Wild frames are copied from the bowmaster extraction of the same WZ skill (Skill/40000.img/skill/400001012).

All-class common 5th-job skills (Erda Shower, Sol Janus, Spider in Mirror, Crest of the Solar) and the Nova-race skill Might of the Nova are out of scope for this pull, as in every other completed class; they are not silently missing.
Six Beginner skills in job 6003 are invisible variants with no name in the skillbook or String/Skill.img; listed as skill-<id> with their frames.
Ball frames are projectile sprites preserved as 'ball' arrays (Kain: Chasing Shot, [Possess/Execute] Unseen Sniper, one invisible Beginner skill).

HEXA book 6314 is complete (48 skills) including Origin Total Annihilation and [Possess/Execute] Churning Malice; V-skill Boost cores live in Skill/50000.img and are recorded as a MISSING stub (separate scan).

skills.name: Possession
skills.description:
Manifest your intrinsic ability to control an aspect of Satiras the Devil Dragon's power.
Create Malice periodically, and/or when a Whispershot skill hits, and gain one cMalice Stone each time it exceeds a certain amount. You can then use Malice Stones to enter a Possessed state that manifests the Malice of Satiras.
When in a Possessed state, most Whispershot skills are enhanced as Possess skills. Using any Possess skill once will cancel the Possessed state. Possess skills ignore both cooldown and ammunition limit, though a Possess skill will go into cooldown after use. Possession can't be used while in a Possessed state. If you use this skill while in the middle of using an attack skill, you can be in a Possessed state without the casting action of Possession.
While Possessed, you can control the Malice that results from a Strike Arrow.
